subject: Final account reconciliation, VAT offset & payout plan
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Beck <simon.beck@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: AC-8921 — reconciliation request and VAT offset proposal

Hi Simon,

Following our call last week I attached the proposed final account statement for the AC-8921 renewal period. There are three items that need quick alignment from your side so we can issue the final invoice and route the residual credit: 

1) Confirm VAT treatment for the July–Sept usage block (we’ve applied standard reverse-charge for services, see sheet).
2) Agree on applying the €14,750 residual credit to the October payout vs. issuing a separate credit note.
3) Approve the bank mandate for the cross-border payout (SEPA/BIC on file).

I’ve included the summary spreadsheet (vat-summary-AC8921.xlsx) and a draft statement (final-statement.pdf) in this message. If you prefer, we can push the credit to next month but that impacts the committed capacity billing run — want to avoid churn.

Can you confirm by EOD Friday so we can close the books for Q3?

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Lead, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment: 20270928-vat-summary-AC8921.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: 20270928-draft-statement.pdf (pdf)

From: Simon Beck <simon.beck@atlascloud.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasCloud Finance <billing@atlascloud.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: AC-8921 — reconciliation request and VAT offset proposal

Rohan,

Thanks for the packet and clear breakdown. Quick answers below: 

- VAT: confirmed, we will accept the reverse-charge approach for services delivered in Q3. Our tax team reviewed the sheet; outstanding VAT withholding items are noted but not material.
- Residual credit: we prefer a single credit note rather than adjusting the Oct payout. Please issue a credit note referencing PO #AC-2109 and we will apply on our ledger.
- Bank mandate: SEPA is fine. Confirm the final BIC (you currently have the old pool BIC on file).

I’m looping in our Finance Ops inbox to speed the credit-note processing. Expect their AP team to request any supporting evidence.

Simon
Simon Beck
Head of Finance, AtlasCloud

Hi Finance Ops team (billing@atlascloud.com),

Thanks, Simon. Per your preference we will issue a single credit note referencing PO #AC-2109. To help AP process the credit, attached is: 

- final-statement.pdf — line-level reconciliation and how the €14,750 was calculated
- vat-summary-AC8921.xlsx — tax positions and our supporting export logs

Action items for AtlasCloud AP: 
- Confirm the contact for receiving the credit note (email + AP ref).
- Advise if you need a signed payout mandate or prefer us to route as a credit note on your ledger.

Marcus — can you please: 
- generate the credit note PDF (system ref CN-AC-2027-10-03) and attach the signed payout mandate if we need to route a payout instead.

Rohan — once CN generated, I’ll sign and send to AtlasCloud with the supporting files.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Customer Billing
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:40:00 +01:00
Subject: CN-AC-2027-10-03 (credit note) + mandate options

Lauren/Rohan —

I’ve generated the credit note as requested. Key details: 
- Credit note ref: CN-AC-2027-10-03
- Amount: €14,750 gross; VAT line shows zero (reverse-charge)
- Source invoice: INV-AC-2027-07-01 through INV-AC-2027-09-30

Two routing options per Simon’s note:

A) Issue credit note and AtlasCloud applies it on their ledger (no payout).
B) Redwood issues credit and offsets against October payout; requires signed SEPA mandate and updated BIC (we need confirmation of AtlasCloud’s receiving BIC).

I attached the generated PDF (CN-AC-2027-10-03.pdf). If we proceed with option B, I also need a signed payout mandate (template attached). Suggest we wait for the AP contact to confirm — Lauren, can you push to billing@atlascloud.com for preference?

Marcus Lin
Billing Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: CN-AC-2027-10-03.pdf (pdf), SEPA-mandate-template.pdf (pdf)

From: AtlasCloud Finance <billing@atlascloud.com>

Date: Mon, 03 Oct 2027 16:42:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: CN-AC-2027-10-03 (credit note) + mandate options

Hi Lauren / Marcus / Rohan,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. AP confirms they will accept a credit note (Option A). Their contact is: Marta Rivas <marta.rivas@atlascloud.com>, ref AP-AC-2109. They do not require a SEPA mandate since they will reconcile the credit internally against PO AC-2109 and our next monthly remittance. 

Please send the signed credit note PDF and the supporting vat-summary spreadsheet to marta.rivas@atlascloud.com. Once received, we’ll close the credit on our side and confirm when the ledger has applied it (should be within 10 business days).

Marta Rivas
Accounts Payable, AtlasCloud
